meta.title: Golf Carts & Products | INNO-F1, INNO-F2 & ROBOCADDY | INNOXONE
meta.description: Explore INNOXONE golf carts: INNO-F1 Original, Light and Marshal, plus INNO-F2 and the ROBOCADDY preview. View model details and contact our team to order.

products.name: INNO-F1 Original
products.headline: Designed for a better golf experience
products.summary: A single-rider electric golf cart with your own seat and space for your clubs.
products.description: The INNO F1 is a single-rider electric golf cart that takes you straight to your ball. No need to share a cart, wait on your partner's shot, or zig-zag across the fairway.
products.alt: Green INNO-F1 Original single-rider electric golf cart with an orange seat and rear golf-bag holder.

story.label: The idea behind Original
story.title: The Story
paragraphs: A two-seat cart ties two golfers to one pace. The F1 gives each player their own ride, so the whole group moves at once. Golfers spend the day playing instead of waiting, and the course gets rounds that finish on time.
story.alt: Green INNO-F1 Original parked beside a fairway.
story.caption: One player. One cart. A personal way to experience the course.

perspectives.label: For your round
perspectives.title: More attention for your next shot.
perspectives.text: Your clubs, your route and your place to pause. Original lets you move to your own ball while staying part of the group. It is a small change in how you travel, with a very personal place in how you play.

perspectives.label: For your course
perspectives.title: Give your golfers another choice.
perspectives.text: From private clubs to public courses, resorts and golf communities, personal mobility can become part of your offering. Explore private ownership, member programs, premium rentals or a demonstration with our team.

founder.quote: It was designed around one golfer, one golf bag, and the freedom to move independently.
founder.name: Young Kim

invitation.title: See where your own ride takes you.
invitation.text: Tell us how and where you play. We can talk through Original, answer your questions and arrange an INNO-F1 test ride at our San Juan Capistrano Gallery.

benefits.title: Play on your own terms
benefits.text: With a two-seat cart, your round runs on someone else’s schedule. The INNO F1 takes you straight to your ball on every shot, with no drop-offs or detours. You set the pace and play your own game.

benefits.title: Less waiting, more golf
benefits.text: When every player has their own cart, nobody sits waiting for a partner to hit. The whole group moves across the course at the same time. Rounds flow better, and golfers spend more of the day swinging, and less of it parked.

benefits.title: A ride you'll enjoy
benefits.text: The INNO F1 is made to be ridden all day. A big, comfortable seat and a smooth ride carry you from tee to green, with a spot for your drink and a charger for your phone.

benefits.title: A new way to play
benefits.text: Getting around the course becomes part of the fun. The INNO F1 turns the drive between shots into something you look forward to. It's a fresh and effective way to play the game you already love.

benefitImage.alt: Four single-rider INNO-F1 carts spread out across the fairway.

cardImage.alt: Front three-quarter rendering of the green INNO-F1 Original with a cognac seat and rear golf bag.

products.name: INNO-F1 Light
products.headline: Lighter. Simpler. Same freedom.
products.summary: Single-rider electric golf mobility with an open-sided layout and slim roof frame.
products.description: The INNO F1 Light is a lightweight single-rider electric golf cart built for easy handling. You still get your own ride straight to your ball, in a simpler build that fits more courses.
products.alt: Red-orange INNO-F1 Light single-rider electric golf cart with slim roof uprights and a rear golf bag.

story.label: The idea behind Light
story.title: Built for courses where space is tight
paragraphs: Resorts, urban courses and smaller properties don't have room for big fleets. The INNO F1 Light gives you the same single-rider experience in a lighter, simpler package. More courses can offer it, and more golfers get to play their way.
story.caption: INNO-F1 Light · Essential single-rider mobility

perspectives.label: For your round
perspectives.title: A straightforward way to make it yours.
perspectives.text: If the idea of a ride of your own feels right, Light is a configuration to explore. See its slim roof frame and dedicated golf-bag space, then talk with us about how it compares with Original.

perspectives.label: For your course
perspectives.title: Start with the golfers you know.
perspectives.text: Some members want more independence. Others are curious about a different way to enjoy their regular round. Light gives your team another single-rider option to discuss as you consider a personal mobility program.

invitation.title: Let’s find your kind of ride.
invitation.text: Tell us what matters to you on the course. Our team can explain the Light configuration, compare it with Original and help you plan the next step.

benefits.title: Easy to handle
benefits.text: Light and compact, the INNO F1 Light is easy to steer, park and move around. Golfers feel comfortable behind the wheel from the first hole. No learning curve, just get on and go.

benefits.title: Just the essentials
benefits.text: Everything you need for a great round and nothing you don't. A simple setup keeps the ride straightforward and the focus on your game. Less to think about, more time to play.

benefits.title: Play on your own terms
benefits.text: Your own cart, straight to your ball on every shot. No drop-offs, no detours and no waiting on a partner. You set the pace for your round.

benefits.title: Your way, more places
benefits.text: Great golf shouldn't depend on how big the course is. The INNO F1 Light brings the INNO experience to resorts, urban courses and tight properties. Wherever you play, you can play your way.

cardImage.alt: Front three-quarter rendering of the red-orange INNO-F1 Light with a black canopy and rear golf bag.

products.name: INNO-F1 Marshal
products.headline: Keep every round moving
products.summary: Electric mobility for marshals and course staff, with a rear utility box.
products.description: The INNO Marshal is a single-rider utility cart built for course staff. It gets marshals across the course fast, carries what they need and makes them easy to spot.
products.alt: White INNO-F1 Marshal single-seat electric golf cart with an orange seat and gray rear utility box.

story.label: The idea behind Marshal
story.title: Get help there before the backup starts
paragraphs: One slow group can back up an entire course. When marshals can't get across the course quickly, small delays turn into crowded tee boxes and frustrated golfers. The INNO F1 Marshal gets your staff to the right hole fast, so every round stays on schedule.
story.caption: INNO-F1 Marshal · Course operations and player assistance

perspectives.label: For your team
perspectives.title: Their own way to get there.
perspectives.text: A marshal, a staff member or a colleague helping a player: each has a reason to be out on the course. Marshal gives that person an individual vehicle and space for everyday course essentials.

perspectives.label: For your golfers
perspectives.title: The human side of course service.
perspectives.text: A welcome, a useful direction or a conversation at the right moment can shape a golfer’s day. Marshal is designed for the team behind those moments, with a focus on course duties and player assistance.

invitation.title: Tell us about your course day.
invitation.text: Share the routes your team covers and what they carry. We can discuss the Marshal configuration, your course requirements and a possible demonstration.

benefits.title: Faster response
benefits.text: Your staff get across the course quickly, wherever they're needed. Slow groups get handled early, and problems get solved on the spot. The groups behind barely notice a thing.

benefits.title: Easy to spot
benefits.text: Golfers know who's coming the moment the Marshal rolls up. Its high-visibility design makes staff stand out across the course. That makes every conversation quicker and easier.

benefits.title: Room for the essentials
benefits.text: Tools, radios and first-aid kits ride along in the rear cargo space. Your team shows up ready to handle whatever the day throws at them.

benefits.title: Built for every shift
benefits.text: The Marshal is built on the proven INNO F1 platform. It's made to handle long days on the course and stays easy to maintain. Your team gets a cart they can count on.

cardImage.alt: Front three-quarter rendering of the white INNO-F1 Marshal with a windshield placard and rear cargo box.

products.name: INNO-F2
products.headline: A fresh perspective. A personal choice.
products.summary: A distinctive roof, broad windshield and open-sided golf cart design.
products.description: The right golf cart should feel like a considered choice. INNO-F2 brings another distinctive design to the INNOXONE collection, with a sculpted roof, broad windshield and open sides.
products.alt: White INNO-F2 golf cart viewed from the front quarter, with an orange seat, roof and windshield.

features.title: A distinctive profile
features.text: A sculpted roof and front frame give INNO-F2 its own identity.

features.title: An open view
features.text: A broad windshield and open sides keep the course in view.

features.title: Find your fit
features.text: Ask our team about specifications, configurations and availability.

story.label: Explore INNO-F2
story.title: Look closer. Picture your own day.
paragraphs: A golf cart becomes part of the way you experience a course. The view from the seat, the shape around you and the feeling of arriving all become part of the day.

INNOXONE’s story begins with people and how they want to move. With INNO-F2, that conversation continues through another design in the collection. Take a closer look, ask what makes it different and explore whether it fits the experience you have in mind.
story.alt: The INNOXONE collection displayed at the San Juan Capistrano Golf Gallery.
story.caption: Explore the collection with our team at the INNOXONE Golf Gallery.

perspectives.label: For your own choice
perspectives.title: Start with what matters to you.
perspectives.text: Tell us where you play and what you want from your next golf cart. We will walk you through INNO-F2’s configuration, specifications and availability so you can make an informed choice.

perspectives.label: For your course
perspectives.title: Consider the experience you want to offer.
perspectives.text: Your golfers, setting and daily operation are the starting point. Discuss INNO-F2 with our team to understand the model and the practical questions that matter before bringing it to your course.

invitation.title: Meet INNO-F2 through a conversation.
invitation.text: We would like to hear what you are looking for. Ask about the current configuration and availability, or plan a Gallery visit to explore the collection.

faq.q: Which INNO-F1 is right for me?
faq.a: Original and Light are single-rider electric golf carts with dedicated golf-bag space. Light has a slim roof frame and an open-sided layout. Marshal is configured for course staff, with a rear utility box. Our team can help you choose.

faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Choose a model and select Request a quote in its product details, or call 949-384-XONE (9663). Our team will confirm your configuration, pricing, availability and delivery arrangements before you place an order.

faq.q: Can I see a golf cart in person?
faq.a: Contact us to arrange a showroom visit at 31896 Plaza Dr Suite D2, San Juan Capistrano, California. Ask which models are available to see and whether a demonstration can be arranged for your visit.
The ROBOCADDY collection is coming to the 2027 Orlando PGA Show in January 2027. The silhouettes are a collection preview. Contact our team with questions about the reveal and future availability.

robocaddy.name: ROBOCADDY®
robocaddy.headline: Walk or Ride. The Choice Is Yours.
robocaddy.description: A new family of personal golf mobility, born from a golfer’s wish to choose how the next nine holes feel. Coming soon at the 2027 Orlando PGA Show.

story.label: The story behind ROBOCADDY
story.title: Nine holes. One simple question.
paragraphs: Several years ago, Young Kim was walking Palo Alto Hills Golf & Country Club in California with a powered caddy carrying his bag. After nine holes, he felt tired. He wanted to ride the remaining nine.

That moment stayed with him. At the 2025 PGA Show, he asked golfers whether they would rather walk or ride. The more revealing question was whether they wanted the freedom to do both during the same round. That idea became the heart of ROBOCADDY.
story.caption: The next chapter of Walk & Ride Golf.

founder.quote: Why can’t golfers walk when they want to walk, and ride when they want to ride?
founder.name: Young Kim

perspectives.label: For golfers
perspectives.title: Your round can change as you do.
perspectives.text: Enjoy the walk. Choose the ride. The ROBOCADDY vision is personal mobility that gives golfers more choice within the same round, with purpose-built designs for different ways to play.

perspectives.label: For course operators
perspectives.title: A broader way to think about mobility.
perspectives.text: The longer-term vision pairs ROBOCADDY with INNOXONE CONNECT AI, a planned platform linking golfers, vehicles and course teams. Improvements to fleet use and course operations are goals to explore through course pilots.

family.name: F1
family.text: Personal single-rider mobility for golfers who want to ride independently.

family.name: F2
family.text: Intelligent two-person mobility, designed around walking, riding or a combination of both.

family.name: SOLO

family.name: DUO
family.text: An intelligent robotic caddy envisioned to support two walking golfers and their equipment.

invitation.text: The family stays in silhouette ahead of its introduction. Tell us how you like to play, or what your course needs, and ask our team about the January 2027 reveal.
